# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Button Door Brave` as a self-contained portrait mobile browser game. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: a canvas game auto-starts with a central actor and four draggable items along the lower playfield. The player drags each item to its matching zone on the actor; all four placements complete a set, raise score by one, add five seconds, and spawn a new set. The timer begins at thirty seconds. If the timer expires, the actor enters a short dying/shake state, then a game-over overlay with restart appears.

The authored world is a Coraline-inspired button-eyed dark fantasy without using protected IP names in the title: uncanny domestic horror, stitched wallpaper, button eyes, candle glow, thread webs, key ribbons, dollhouse doors, handmade props, child bravery, sinister wonder, and storybook nightmare tone. Use a memorable button-eyed child/doll focal actor. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art rather than stock backgrounds. Optimize for portrait aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16, with readable HUD chips and touch-friendly restart.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile canvas drag-and-place timed arcade toy.
- objective: place four draggable props onto four matching zones on a central plush/actor before the timer expires.
- input model: pointer/touch drag from bottom prop row, move with a slight upward offset, release to test placement.
- core loop: spawn actor and four props, drag each prop to its target zone, complete all four, actor exits upward, score increments, timer gains a bonus, next set spawns.
- fail/friction state: timer reaches zero, actor shakes in a dying state, game-over overlay appears, restart fully resets score/time/items.

## Protected Mechanics
- Four required items, four body zones, free placement order, timer starts at 30 seconds, completed set adds one score and five seconds.
- RequestAnimationFrame update loop, bottom item spawning, placed items following actor, and scoped canvas pointer handling are protected.
- Game states remain PLAYING, ANIMATING, DYING, and GAMEOVER in behavior even if UI language changes.

## Remix Blueprint
Button Door Brave reframes the loop as a brave child/doll sealing an uncanny other-house door by stitching four charms into place. The player still performs the same drag-and-place rescue under time pressure, but the world now reads as button-eyed domestic dark fantasy: stitched wallpaper, button moon/door, candle glow, yarn hair, thread particles, and handmade charms.
